audit_log.rationale: Collected competitors, pain points, and demand signals concurrently.

The AI CRM market is rapidly growing but research reveals three critical gaps we can exploit: (1) Reddit communities consistently complain about CRM complexity, poor adoption, and excessive data entry — our zero-input AI enrichment and conversational interface directly solve the #1 adoption killer; (2) Existing AI CRM leaders like Salesforce Einstein and HubSpot AI charge premium 'agent taxes' on top of already expensive seats, creating a pricing umbrella for a purpose-built AI-native alternative at 50-70% lower cost; (3) Demand signals show traction for solo/small-team CRMs (Startr, Jesty) but no strong mid-market AI-native player has emerged between 'solo founder tools' and enterprise behemoths. By targeting the 5-100 employee sweet spot with a generous free tier for viral adoption, transparent per-seat pricing without hidden AI surcharges, and a product that genuinely reduces CRM busywork through AI (not just adds AI badges to legacy workflows), Helix can capture the massive segment of teams graduating from spreadsheets or free HubSpot who want modern AI capabilities without enterprise complexity or cost. Go-to-market should be product-led growth via the free tier, content marketing targeting 'HubSpot alternatives' and 'best AI CRM' search intent, and community-driven growth through Reddit and indie hacker channels where CRM dissatisfaction is most vocal.
